schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Scotts Lake (Region 2, Alpine Co.) for sub-catchable-size Lahontan Cutthroat Trout under the Put and Grow program, with a stated release month range of June-July. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
